subject: Re: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - EZE / 153 CTN 1,247 KGS
body:
Thank you for clarifying that pickup on 25 November 2026 is quoted but not yet booked.

Could you please confirm that the offer is for our shipment to SGN, as the subject line refers to EZE? Please provide one all-in total in a single currency for the most economical option, including pickup from our site in 84789 and all charges through to SGN.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer asks for clarification and a revised all-in total for the quoted shipment, without accepting or rejecting the offer.
